reason: V43 gives the best current app-scale Triceratops read while keeping the anti-rhino gates: exactly two brow horns plus one nasal horn, a skull-attached frill, closed beak, long visible tail, four dinosaur limbs, and separated non-hoofed toes. V41 remains a strong low-body comparison, but v43 has a more familiar skull/frill/toe read. V44 is useful but rounder in the torso, and v45 keeps a long low body but has heavier head/mouth risk.

body is a round mammal barrel rather than low elongated ceratopsian form
